description.text:
Position Overview
We are seeking a visionary and highly skillful AI Research Scientist to spearhead the development of next-generation foundation models for precision health. Positioned at the dynamic intersection of AI4Science and clinical medicine, you will design, train, and deploy individual-mode and multimodal foundation models. Your mission will be to harmoniously fuse disparate, complementary biomedical modalities to unlock breakthroughs in disease risk score prediction, patient risk stratification, personalized nutrition, and clinical treatment recommendations etc.
The ideal candidate inherently straddles both domains: possessing the rigorous mathematical and engineering foundational skills required to train large-scale Transformer architectures, alongside the domain expertise necessary to interpret genomic, longitudinal, and clinical phenotypes.
Job description:
•Foundation Model Development: Research, design, and pre-train self-supervised and self-attention foundation models tailored for individual health modalities.
•Multimodal Data Fusion: Develop novel architectures leveraging cross-attention mechanisms and contrastive learning to align and fuse heterogeneous data streams, including genome, demographics, clinical EHR, lifestyle factors, and high-frequency
longitudinal streams.
•Precision Health Application: Translate fused multimodal representations into downstream clinical tasks: Polygenic Risk Score (PRS) modeling, multi-disease risk stratification, personalized nutrition algorithms, and actionable clinical decision support.
•Scalable Engineering: Build, optimize, and maintain robust training and deployment pipelines for large-scale models utilizing modern deep learning frameworks.
•Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration: Act as the technical translator and strategic bridge between AI engineering teams, bioinformaticians, and medical clinicians to validate models against real-world clinical benchmarks.

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
工作技能
1. Artificial Intelligence & Deep Learning
•Architectures: Deep expertise in Transformer architectures, self-supervised learning, and advanced representation learning. Proven experience utilizing cross-attention or gating mechanisms for multimodal alignment.
•Frameworks: Advanced proficiency in PyTorch and/or JAX for constructing, debugging, and scaling neural networks.
•Deployment: Practical experience with distributed training (e.g., DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM) and deploying models into production environments.
•Time-Series Analysis: Strong background in representation learning for irregular or high-frequency time-series data.
2. Biomedical, Genomics & Clinical Domain Knowledge
•Statistical Genetics: Direct experience with Polygenic Risk Score (PRS) modeling, linkage disequilibrium, or integrating GWAS summary statistics into deep learning workflows.
•Multimodal Modalities: Hands-on experience handling and preprocessing a diverse array of health data:
oGenomics: Variant data, sequence data.
oLongitudinal/Sensor: Wearables or biometric time-series.
oClinical & Lifestyle: Electronic Health Records (EHR), ICD codes, demographic profiles and dietary/lifestyle logs.
•Pathophysiology Knowledge: Solid clinical literacy regarding chronic disease conditions.
其他條件
1.Education: Ph.D. or Master’s degree with equivalent deep industry experience in Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Biomedical Engineering, Computational Biology, or a highly quantitative AI4Science-related field.
2.Experience: 3+ years of post-degree research or industry experience building and scaling complex deep learning models (peer-reviewed publications at top AI/ML conferences like NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, or top-tier nature/medical journals is a major plus).
3.Mindset: A highly collaborative, mission-driven researcher who thrives on messy, heterogeneous real-world data and cares deeply about moving AI from theoretical benchmarks to tangible patient impact.
